answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 9532 Country: India Title: Assalaam ale kum, I m a married woman. Pls answer my query-- I m vegetrian n sometime my husband and in laws insist me to eat non vegetarian item which i dont like though i cook for him. Am i doing sin by disobeying my husband n others? Kindly reply- Jazakallah Question: Assalaam ale kum, I m a married woman. Pls answer my query-- I m vegetrian n sometime my husband and in laws insist me to eat non vegetarian item which i dont like though i cook for him. Am i doing sin by disobeying my husband n others? Kindly reply- Jazakallah Answer ID: 9532 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1672/1367=L/1429) You shall not be regarded sinful for being disobedient, since you naturally do not like to eat meat. However, it is not good to be habitual of avoiding a lawful thing; you should gradually take to eating it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
